about: The patterns rerun-failed.py knows already, and the shortest handling for each. What the run object carries is the workflow path and the event — not the failed job names and not the log — so match names those two; different keys intersect and the values under one key are alternatives. rerun false means the run is not one a retry helps; true means a rerun is the standard response and the handling is printed with it. A pattern only ever explains a refusal or annotates a rerun: none of them widens what the five gates in rerun-failed.py already allow. Written 2026-10-16, moving these per-incident notes out of task histories.

patterns.title: Dependabot 的 dynamic 运行：npm 注册表 502
patterns.action: 不是本分支的代码问题，重跑助手也不收 dynamic 运行；核日志里的 502 与同批其他作业，写明依据关掉被它重开的任务。
symptoms: 对 registry.npmjs.org 的请求零星 502（如 /pluralize、/@inquirer），updater 以 private_source_authentication_failure 退出——那是够不到注册表时的报法，不是鉴权问题（2026-10-15 c111caeb / PR #3788）
同一次运行的另外几条 Dependabot 作业全绿

patterns.title: DB backup freshness check：只按 schedule 跑的运维检查
patterns.action: 不跟提交，重跑没有意义；核 run 历史里它是不是在无关提交上红同样几步，写明理由关掉被它重开的任务，不改代码。
symptoms: 步骤 7 uploads mirror: missing success marker (/home/nictheboy/backups/.last-uploads-mirror-success)
步骤 8 Prepare read-only R2 check dependencies：dev runner 上 python3 -m venv 失败，ensurepip 不可用、缺 python3.13-venv
步骤 9 因此 R2 freshness check failed: ModuleNotFoundError；2026-10-09 起每天在无关提交上红同样这三步

patterns.title: box-uptime 的 dev-health：站点探活抖动
patterns.action: 合并不会触发它，只是那一小时正好落在合并提交上；看同一提交前后几轮的 box-uptime（同 SHA 上绿红都有即坐实），写明理由关掉任务，不改代码。
symptoms: 日志里 attempt N: 那两行——拿到 200 但耗时压线（2026-10-16 11:56 为 5176ms / 阈值 5000ms），或两次都 503、各约 15.6 秒

patterns.title: Required CI 的 PR 运行：重跑失败 job 是标准处置
patterns.action: 重跑失败 job（上限 3 次）；同一个 head 上再红就按真实回归读日志，别当偶发收场。
symptoms: backend / integration：tests/integration/test_a_last_step_lands_while_work_goes_on.py::test_a_message_sent_while_the_task_is_written_up_is_not_dropped[turn-waiting] 红在 assert 'closed' == 'open'，重跑就过
backend / integration：tests/integration/test_claude_session_records.py::test_a_message_after_a_dead_runner_gets_a_turn 的 orphaned 断言，--reruns 1 无效，重新采纳进队

patterns.title: 重跑助手自己的运行红了
patterns.action: 不是测试失败，是重跑助手按设计拒收了一个不该重跑的 run，或要重跑的 run 已经自己变绿；核合并提交上 CI required 是 success 后，写明依据关掉任务。
symptoms: ::error:: 那行写着理由：run <id> is queued/None, not a completed failure；is completed/success, not a completed failure；或 is on attempt 3; the limit is 3
